slice.name: Mochi
slice.body: Original soft-hearted monster; preserve existing artwork and silhouette
slice.battleHook: Comfort blanket: guarding builds one shield for an ally
slice.keeperHook: Grows unusual garden plants through varied care

slice.name: Bolt
slice.body: Original curious little robot; preserve existing artwork and silhouette
slice.battleHook: Salvage charge: blocked hits power a bounded counterattack
slice.keeperHook: Repairs habitat gadgets and discovers crafting patterns

slice.name: Zee
slice.body: Original cosmic daydreamer; preserve existing artwork and silhouette
slice.personality: Dreamy observer with oddly specific questions
slice.battleHook: Orbit: alternating support and attack changes the next move
slice.keeperHook: Maps constellations and finds nocturnal discoveries
slice.carePreference: Quiet observation and a clean resting place

slice.name: Ember
slice.body: Original pocket dragon with tiny wings; preserve existing artwork and silhouette
slice.personality: Brave, protective, proud of accidental cooking
slice.battleHook: Banked heat: rest stores one controlled burst, then clears
slice.keeperHook: Warms incubation nests and creates fired-clay decorations

slice.name: Mosswisp
slice.body: Low six-legged moss lattice with a single hanging seed lantern
slice.battleHook: Root relay: planted marks pass a small heal between allies
slice.keeperHook: Restores forest paths and identifies medicinal plants

slice.name: Brinebell
slice.body: Inverted translucent bell body on three jointed shell feet
slice.battleHook: Undertow: changes initiative once after a defended hit
slice.keeperHook: Records tide songs and uncovers shell mosaics

slice.name: Craggle
slice.body: Asymmetric mineral-backed burrower with a broad shovel snout
slice.battleHook: Brace: slow preparation resists knockback and boosts one hit
slice.keeperHook: Opens safe cave routes and finds carving stone
slice.carePreference: Rest after digging and mineral-balanced food

slice.name: Kitefin
slice.body: Thin triangular glider with ribbon rudders and folding fan fins
slice.battleHook: Slipstream: shifts an ally ahead at a stamina cost
slice.keeperHook: Charts storm fronts and retrieves canopy seeds

slice.name: Rimehorn
slice.body: Compact four-legged shaggy creature with one broad crescent ice sail
slice.personality: Reserved until it trusts its keeper
slice.battleHook: Thaw reserve: spends stored frost for protection or healing
slice.keeperHook: Preserves rare seeds and builds snow shelters

slice.name: Siltstilts
slice.body: Tall two-legged reed mimic with a filter pouch and tiny paddle arms
slice.battleHook: Filter: converts one poison stack into a limited defense buff
slice.keeperHook: Cleans wetlands and discovers hidden amphibian nurseries

slice.name: Duneglass
slice.body: Radial five-limbed glass-plated crawler surrounding a sand-filled lens
slice.battleHook: Refraction: telegraphs a stance that redirects one energy move
slice.keeperHook: Aligns light puzzles to uncover fossils and colored-glass recipes
slice.carePreference: Clean lens plates and shaded rest

slice.name: Vesperveil
slice.body: Floating folded mantle with two mask plates and long hanging feelers
slice.personality: Dry humor, protective of forgotten places
slice.battleHook: False opening: a clearly signaled feint punishes repeated attacks
slice.keeperHook: Deciphers ruin rubbings and curates recovered relic displays
slice.carePreference: Quiet study balanced with social play
